name: Chicken Parmigiana
steps: Dip the chicken breasts in the beaten egg, then coat in the breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
Fry the breaded chicken in the olive oil over medium heat until golden and cooked through to 74C internal.
Spoon the tomato sauce over the chicken and top with the mozzarella.
Bake at 200C until the cheese melts and the chicken is piping hot.
